TR-MCP-FEDERATION-014.title: original-provider-to-Dolt migration tool contract
TR-MCP-FEDERATION-014.body: MigrationManifest binds MigrationId, mode, ProjectId, source provider/snapshot hash, schema versions, table counts, typed row hashes, alias decisions, audit backfill and immutable destination commit. Ph3 implements seed, dry-run/resume/verify and Dolt-to-new-SQLite project recovery; join is unavailable until Ph6 review/publication exist. Both lab sources are SQLite; PostgreSQL and SQL Server remain supported fixture sources. Retain originals read-only. Recovery quiesces the owner and captures every branch, including unpublished heads and dirty working sets, without creating history commits. Export one new compatible SQLite DB per branch containing ALL B2-classified versioned domains: TODO child/link/document graphs, requirements/mappings, use-case actors/flows/steps, workspace memories, portable configuration, promoted session graphs and permanent aliases. Preserve IDs, values, timestamps, versions, soft deletes and audit linkage. Manifest binds branch/head/working-set/schema/count/hash evidence; retain immutable Dolt objects/refs to preserve ancestry outside SQLite. export-todos remains a subset, never whole-project rollback acceptance. Missing domain/branch or failed validation blocks routing changes. Operator selects the verified active snapshot; others remain readable recovery artifacts. Capture host-local control/audit/outbox/IdentityServer backups at the same quiescence boundary and verify restore plus hub audit resend. Cutover requires verified receipts, explicit DEPLOY HOLD release and one-node soak before the second host.
